sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह ।वाक्यं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा प्रोवाच लक्ष्मणम् ।। ७.१०२.१ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā harṣamāpede rāghavo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।vākyaṁ cādbhutasaṅkāśaṁ tadā provāca lakṣmaṇam ।। 7.102.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that, Rama, along with his brothers, felt great joy and then spoke amazing words to Lakshmana.
